turns.replyTail:
hipping address on an order I just placed?

Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

No — once an order is placed, it can’t be canceled, so there isn’t a cancellation window. Orders move into processing right away, which means we’re unable to stop or modify them after checkout.
